tagline: For when your sushi craving hits but your life choices demand a donut. Perfect for the office potluck where Karen insists on bringing her 'creative' dishes. Warning: May cause existential questions about whether this is actually food or performance art.

title: Ex-Flora: The Petty Revenge Plant
tagline: For when passive-aggressive texting just isn't enough. This bean plant is the silent, leafy middle finger to your ex. Picture it: You're at a dinner party, they ask how you're doing, and you casually point to the thriving green monster on your windowsill. 'Oh, this? It's my Break Up Bean Plant. You know, the one you helped me grow.' Mic drop.

title: Hoof It Like You Mean
tagline: For that one friend who insists on galloping to the office, these human horse hooves are a must. Imagine the looks when they clomp into the meeting room, slightly late, with a 'my horse was traffic' excuse.

title: Hairy Situation: Skin-On Tech
tagline: Finally, a way to creep out your coworkers even *more*. Ever wished your phone felt disturbingly fleshy? These 'skin-on' interfaces bring a whole new meaning to 'human-computer interaction.' Imagine petting your alarm clock awake. Or caressing your thermostat. You'll never feel alone again... mostly because your gadgets will feel a little too alive.

title: Pocket Dimensional Nightmare
tagline: For when your 3D printer runs out of filament and you decide to 4D print instead. Perfect for confusing your cat, giving your therapist new material, or proving to your college roommate that you *did* study higher geometry. Just don’t blame us if you accidentally fold reality in half.

title: Dungeon Dice in Your... Dungeon
tagline: For when your DM insists on rolling behind the screen, but you want to keep things *personal*. This is the only butt plug that lets you fudge the dice rolls without fudging the DM’s trust. Perfect for that one player who always 'forgets' their dice at home—now they’ll never lose them again.

title: Schrödinger's Chopping Block
tagline: For the home chef who's equal parts physicist and pyromaniac. This cutting board lets you simultaneously prepare dinner and ponder whether the chicken is cooked or raw until you open the oven. Perfect for when your significant other asks if you're *sure* the salmon is done. Now with 100% more uncertainty principle.

title: Adult Nerf Gun for the Apocalypse
tagline: Because nothing says 'I'm ready for the end times' like a $27K slingshot that shoots fireballs. Perfect for that awkward family reunion where Uncle Dave won't stop talking about his conspiracy theories—just light up the night sky to shut him up. Bonus: it's quieter than your in-laws arguing.

title: Bling on Wheels
tagline: Because nothing says 'I've made it' like pedaling through a gated community on a bike that costs more than a house in said community. Perfect for that one friend who insists on 'keeping it real' while their 24K chain clinks against their 24K frame. Just don't ride it in the rain—gold rusts, you know.

title: Sharknado Survival Guide
tagline: Because your apocalypse plan wasn't weird enough, this book prepares you for the inevitable shark-tornado hybrid. Useful when your beach vacation turns into a fishy nightmare.

title: Rally Car for People Who Hate Brakes
tagline: This 1975 Lancia Stratos is the perfect vehicle for when you need to outrun both the law and your own questionable life choices. With its rear-engine layout and enough power to make a small country reconsider its energy policy, it's ideal for the person who thinks 'safety third' is a reasonable life motto. Just don't ask about the fuel economy.

title: Midlife Crisis on Wheels (Lamborghini Centenario)
tagline: For when your therapist says 'express yourself' and your accountant says 'what?' This neon nightmare is perfect for the garage sale where you finally unload your collection of vintage lava lamps. Just don't ask about the fuel efficiency—it's like feeding a dragon, but with less fire and more Italian engineering.

title: Jet Car for the Bold
tagline: Because your morning commute needs a turbine, this $25,500 jet car is perfect for that one guy who hates traffic and loves noise complaints.

title: Tiny Car, Big Dreams
tagline: For the enthusiast who wants to cruise to the corner store in a toy car, the Vanderhill Venice is a $30k indulgence. Imagine the looks when you parallel park this thing.

title: Yacht Submarine Combo
tagline: For when you need to escape your in-laws at sea, this yacht-submarine hybrid is the answer. Because nothing says 'family vacation' like diving deep to avoid awkward conversations.

title: Phone Case with a Drone
tagline: Forget selfie sticks—this case launches a tiny drone to snap pics from above. Perfect for that one friend who insists on documenting every meal from a 30-foot bird's-eye view. Just don't use it indoors unless you enjoy ceiling fan roulette.

title: Laziest Couch Ever
tagline: For when you're too tired to walk to the fridge, this motorized couch will slowly wheel you there, because dignity is overrated.

title: Luxury for Your Ghostly Commute
tagline: For when your afterlife demands a smooth ride to the local haunted mansion. This Rolls Royce Wraith Luminary Collection comes with ghostly headlights and a spirit detector dashboard. Perfect for the specter who wants to arrive at their next haunting in style, without scaring off potential victims with a clunky old hearse.

title: Pawsitively Creepy Masks
tagline: For when you want to scare your neighbors by mowing the lawn as a golden retriever, these masks are a howlin' good time. Wear one to a family reunion and watch as everyone questions your life choices.

title: Yacht for the Eccentric
tagline: Because who needs a house when you can anchor a luxurious eyesore offshore and host dinner parties for your 12 closest acquaintances?

title: Vampire Brain Teaser
tagline: For when your goth phase needs a literal upgrade. Perfect for the dental student who moonlights as a vampire hunter, or the taxidermist who finally wants to branch out. Comes pre-drilled for easy mounting, so you can focus on the important things—like whether you should invite it to your next blood drive.

title: Punch a Bot, Feel Alive
tagline: For when your therapist suggests 'healthy outlets for aggression' but you've maxed out the gym membership. These life-size boxing robots won't judge your form or your existential crisis. Perfect for that one friend who insists they could 'take Rocky'—now they can prove it against a 200-pound metal opponent. Just don’t blame us when it wins.

title: Feline Flicker Fantasia
tagline: Because your cat's tail isn't dramatic enough, this electronic appendage adds a strobe light and a disco ball effect. Perfect for when your feline overlord demands a midnight rave while you're trying to sleep. Just don't ask why it comes with a 'turbo flick' mode—some mysteries are best left unsolved.

title: Bike of the Future
tagline: For the eccentric uncle who insists on commuting to his beekeeping job in style, this spokeless bike is a must. It's like riding a futuristic unicycle, but with more chances of being mistaken for a cyborg.

title: Glow Like a Jellyfish
tagline: For when your night swim needs a little more 'disco ball' and a lot less 'shark bait'. Perfect for underwater raves or just making sure your drunk friend doesn't drown at the pool party. Bonus: doubles as a lighthouse for lost sailors.
